query: UPDATE bookings b SET reminder_sent_at = now(), updated_at = now() FROM branch_booking_settings s WHERE s.branch_id = b.branch_id AND s.reminder_lead_minutes IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM branches fb JOIN organizations fo ON fo.id = fb.org_id WHERE fb.id = b.branch_id AND fo.plan = 'free') AND b.status = 'confirmed' AND b.reminder_sent_at IS NULL AND b.starts_at > now() AND b.starts_at <= now() + make_interval(mins => s.reminder_lead_minutes) AND b.created_at < b.starts_at - make_interval(mins => s.reminder_lead_minutes) RETURNING b.id
